main_text.l: CAROLVM EMANVELIS PHILIBERTI FILIVM SABAUDIAE Ducem à suscipiendo bello aduersus Geneuenses dehortatur.

l.i: NE bella Genti tristia liberæ Fidens Iberum fœderibus pares: Afferre ne vicinus vltro Innocuæ mediteris vrbi Ignota sæclis vincla prioribus, Princeps potentum progenies Ducum, Qui culta Telluris Sabaudæ Imperiis tenuere iustis. Natum Parentis iussa nouissima, Vrgente fato si memorem mouent, Præfer duellis luctuosis Ocia pacis amata tutæ. Antiqua nostra quid referam domus Exempla, dixit, cerne recentia, Non auspicato Marte damna Quanta tulit pater ante victus. Quum Gallus hostis signa potentior Infesta nostris finibus intulit, Et Berna, promissum fidelis

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut ornamental letter, joined to the first word as "NE". Catchword "Auxi-" is at lower right. The first stanza's ornament and the stray marks at the page edges are not transcribed.
